entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2572221764290136192: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 8198: distance 85.69 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.057), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 85.69 +/- 4.884 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 12.5296 +/- 0.1277 mas (same row, RUWE 2.62), 98.2 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 71.227, 53.727 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 16.177 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 8198: radius 16.177 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 148.593 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.076) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5014 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 8198: effective temperature 5014 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.066).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 XP spectrum, source 2572221764290136192, cross-checked against Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 89: HR 510; VizieR III/202 (4 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe8d0. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 10761 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 510 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 510 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: BS 510 is not in part2; gaia-xp: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,014 K and log g 2.77 (u1 0.624, u2 0.151): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 2.77 from 2024A&A...683A.125P; the 11 published values span log g 2.43 to 2.9, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness.
